title: Whopper® / Wrapper example
slide_intent: Connect a product name to its package clearly so the customer can identify the item before opening it.
strategic_value: The Whopper wordmark can anchor ingredient illustration and operational marks without losing product recognition.
demonstration: A wrapped burger sits on brown, with the Whopper name centered above small food icons and service-marking boxes; colorful vegetable illustrations wrap around the edges.
practical_value: Compare product-name prominence against illustration and functional markings on a crumpled wrapper.

content_islands.name: Wrapper form
content_islands.spec: Center the wrapped burger on brown, retaining its folds and shadow.

content_islands.name: Product and operational information
content_islands.spec: Keep the Flame-Grilled line, large Whopper name, icon row and small marking boxes grouped at the center.

content_islands.name: Ingredient illustration
content_islands.spec: Retain the colored vegetable fragments around the wrapper perimeter.

reference_purposes.Expression: Warm paper, brown lettering and vegetable illustrations carry the food-led identity.
reference_purposes.Application: The Whopper signature appears on a complete burger wrapper.
